spiritgiven.comments: Latvia was great at communicating effectively and quickly when a spirit issue occurred. They also kept positive attitudes through the game which was also appreciated.
Team Austria was extremely receptive and had very good communication. They made an effort to high five everyone when coming off a point or even just walking down the sideline.
There was some dangerous plays in the first half but after communicating, they made safer plays and overall kept good body control.

Poland had very good communication and corrected each other on poor calls. They did a good job adjusting to match our physicality and keeping it at a good level the whole game. There were two instances of dangerous plays on their part, but they were very receptive when we addressed it.
The Netherlands did a great job communicating throughout the game. This was a very clean game that stayed positive from both ends throughout. We also loved the spirit circle with them at the end!

Team Canada had good level of physicality considering the intensity of the game. There were a few times they called picks that could have been avoided by them, but overall good communication and great game.

Team Italy did a great job at keeping positive and spirited throughout a very competitive match. Although we did not bring this up during games we believe that team Italy was committing many marking violations by being too close on the mark.
This was a very spirited game they communicated effectively and we had no issues that could not be resolved between matchups. They made great plays that always were safe and did not make contact.

spiritreceived.comments: It was so lovely to play against you! We loved your smiles, your high fives and your communication! Maybe we’ll see each other again in the bracket games ;)

USA X , thank you for a high intensity and good spirited game. We really enjoyed playing you and the thing that stood out was your communication, the calls that were there were resolved quickly and we liked that because that keeps you in the game better. Again thank you so much for the game and good luck with the rest of the tournament :)
Greetings NED X

hi USA! it was an honor to play with you, a dream for most of us. We learnt a lot from your fair-mindedness and we loved to see a team as close as you. You always cheered, screamed and talked to your mates on the field from the side and it seemed liked you were all together on the field and not only 7. thank you, it’s an experience we’ll always bring with us and remember. love you, good luck and go high!❤️
Very intensive and enjoyable match! Good luck for the finals.
